title: MT - DEA LPR Program Summary Data

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting the following records about the DEA National License Plate Reader Program in Montana:
1. A list of Montana state, local, and tribal agencies that have signed a memorandum of understanding with DEA to share license plate reader information through the program, with the date DEA signed each one.
2. The quarterly statistical reports of arrests, drug seizures, and asset seizures that Montana partner agencies sent to DEA, including by email to LPR@dea.gov, under those memoranda. This includes the reports from the Valley County Sheriff's Office under its memorandum signed by DEA on August 23, 2024.
3. Any summary, tally, or spreadsheet DEA prepared from those reports for Montana agencies.

I would prefer records in electronic form, and spreadsheets in CSV or XLSX where they exist.
Time range: January 1, 2024 through the date of search.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
